title: Governor Pryce
description: As governor of the Lothal Sector, Arihnda Pryce was a confident leader with a firm belief in the Empire. Because of her position, she was tasked with eliminating the Rebel threat on the planet. This directive meant dealing with the Rebels of Phoenix Squadron— specifically Hera Syndulla and the rest of the crew of the Ghost. Because of their resourcefulness, Pryce was forced to resort to increasingly cruel and desperate measures. By the end, she destroyed her own fuel depot in a massive explosion to eliminate just one of their numbers.
